newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPS TO PIVOT AROUND 135.50.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPS TO PIVOT AROUND 135.50.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will be confined to a range on Monday, centred on the 135.50 level, technical analysts said.
"BTPs look rangebound and will pivot around 135.50 today, but the trend may come out to the downside," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
September BTPs were trading at 135.69 at 0728 GMT, up 29 basis points. The contract reached a low of 135.30 and high of 135.75 so far in Monday's session.
The drag of the T-bond sell-off may allow the BTP contract to test support around 134.70-90, but that will hold, Wood said.
The 134.70-90 band encompasses the 134.73 daily chart low hit on August 6 and comes in just below Friday's low of 134.97.
"A decline below Friday's 134.97 low puts the recent 134.73 cycle low under pressure, while a decline below 134.73 suggests a test of 134.00," Chase analysts said in a research note.
The 134.00 level represents the lower boundary of a long-term ascending trend channel on weekly charts, Chase said.
The strength of Bunds in the face of the T-bond sell-off may enable BTPs to push ahead initially to the high 135.00s, low 136.00s, Wood said.
"There is clear resistance around 136.20-136.30," he added.
"A move above 136.21 takes it above the short-term descending trend channel developed since July," said Chase. Next important resistance is at 137.48, Chase added.
September Eurolira futures were two basis points higher at 93.21 at 0739 GMT.
